name: Morse-Vail telegraph key
description: A Morse-Vail telegraph key from about 1844, a scan of the museum object

licence.statement: Listed as CC0 on its Smithsonian 3D record (seen in a search result on 2026-11-09; the record page itself would not load for us and the Open Access API refused the lookup, so this one is not read from the record directly).

source.name: Smithsonian Open Access
authors: Smithsonian National Museum of American History, Digitization Program Office

changes: Passed through: the geometry, texture coordinates, material and textures are the museum's own, unchanged. Added: a root that puts the model on the scene's axes, in metres, centred on its own middle, and a tag on the part.
caveats: A single scanned or modelled object: it can be labelled as a whole, but has no named parts to cut or take apart.
The source's textures are larger than the page draws them at; they are reduced when loaded, to the size each tier allows.
